convert_quat_to_rotation_matrix: use quat_to_mat to convert a quaternion into a 3x3 rotation matrix
convert_euler_to_quaternion: use euler_to_quat to convert Euler angles into a quaternion representation
compose_quaternions: use quat_mul to multiply two quaternions and compose their rotations
interpolate_quaternions: use quat_slerp to spherically interpolate between two quaternions by a given fraction
build_homogeneous_transform: use pos_quat_to_hmat to build a 4x4 homogeneous transformation matrix from position and quaternion
